title: SCRUM-84: PwD - View Available Purchase Options - Accessibility Test Plan
overview: Accessibility test plan for purchase options in Contact Vendor popup: Buy Online heading as semantic h2/h3, purchase links with accessible labels describing action+destination, target=_blank with 'opens in new tab' indication, keyboard operable, consistent style, broken links hidden, no-links message announced, responsive layout.

testCases.title: Buy Online heading is semantic h2 or h3
steps: Verify heading is h2 or h3

testCases.title: Purchase links have accessible labels with action and destination
steps: Verify aria-label describes action and destination (e.g. 'Buy on Amazon – opens in new tab')

testCases.title: External links indicate 'opens in new tab'
steps: Verify aria-label or visually hidden text includes 'opens in new tab'

testCases.title: Purchase links keyboard operable with Tab/Enter/Space
Focus indicators on purchase links ≥3:1 contrast
Purchase link text contrast meets 4.5:1
steps: Inspect link text color and background

testCases.title: Link states (default, hover, focus, visited) visually distinct
Broken or inactive links hidden programmatically
steps: Verify it is not rendered in DOM or has display:none
Verify not just visually grayed out

testCases.title: No-links message displayed and announced when no purchase options
steps: Navigate to product with no purchase links
Verify message 'No online purchase options currently available'

testCases.title: Focus order logical within Buy Online section
Purchase links touch targets ≥44x44px on mobile
No unexpected navigation after clicking purchase link
expectedResults: No unexpected navigation on original page

testCases.title: Screen reader announces link purpose and context
steps: Navigate to purchase link with screen reader
Verify announcement includes action, destination, and new tab

testCases.title: Buy Online section usable at 200% zoom
steps: Verify Buy Online section visible and usable
